source.text_it: Il gruppo di regolazione e controllo dell'impianto frenante pneumatico agisce sul cambio

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system regulation and control unit acts on the gearbox.

source.text_it: Il gruppo di regolazione e controllo dell'impianto frenante pneumatico ha il compito di mantenere la pressione dell'aria nei serbatoi entro il valore minimo e massimo

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system regulation and control unit keeps tank air pressure between minimum and maximum values.

source.text_it: Il gruppo di regolazione e controllo dell'impianto frenante pneumatico ha il compito di evitare pericolose sovrappressioni nei serbatoi

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system regulation and control unit prevents dangerously excessive tank pressure.

source.text_it: Il gruppo di regolazione e controllo dell'impianto frenante pneumatico impedisce il ritorno dell'aria contenuta nei serbatoi

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system regulation and control unit prevents air in the tanks from flowing back.

source.text_it: I serbatoi dell'impianto frenante pneumatico sono collaudati alla pressione di un'atmosfera

records.localized_text: Pneumatic braking system tanks are tested at a pressure of one atmosphere.

source.text_it: I serbatoi dell'impianto frenante pneumatico immagazzinano l'aria generata durante la fase di compressione nei cilindri del motore

records.localized_text: Pneumatic braking system tanks store air generated during compression in the engine cylinders.

source.text_it: I serbatoi dell'impianto frenante pneumatico accumulano aria destinata ai freni

records.localized_text: Pneumatic braking system tanks store air intended for the brakes.

source.text_it: L'impianto frenante di un autocarro o di un autobus è munito di freno di soccorso

records.localized_text: A truck or bus braking system has an emergency brake.

source.text_it: L'impianto frenante di un autocarro o di un autobus realizza la frenatura di servizio e quella di soccorso agendo, di norma, sul solo pedale del freno

records.localized_text: A truck or bus braking system normally provides service and emergency braking using only the brake pedal.

source.text_it: L'inserimento del freno di stazionamento è segnalato da un'apposita spia sul cruscotto

records.localized_text: A dashboard warning light indicates when the parking brake is engaged.

source.text_it: Il distributore duplex distribuisce l'aria inviandola ai serbatoi dell'impianto frenante pneumatico

records.localized_text: The duplex valve distributes air to the pneumatic braking system tanks.

source.text_it: Il distributore duplex è azionato da una leva a comando manuale posta vicino al volante

records.localized_text: The duplex valve is operated by a manual lever near the steering wheel.

source.text_it: Il distributore duplex consente il passaggio dell'aria compressa contenuta nei serbatoi verso l'impianto frenante pneumatico

records.localized_text: The duplex valve allows compressed air stored in the tanks to flow to the pneumatic braking system.

source.text_it: Il distributore duplex di un impianto di frenatura pneumatico consente di modulare l'intensità della frenata

records.localized_text: A pneumatic braking system duplex valve allows braking intensity to be modulated.

source.text_it: Il distributore duplex di un impianto di frenatura pneumatico distribuisce la differente velocità di rotazione delle ruote motrici in curva

records.localized_text: A pneumatic braking system duplex valve distributes the different rotational speeds of driven wheels on bends.

source.text_it: Il distributore duplex non può essere installato nei veicoli muniti di cambio epicicloidale

records.localized_text: The duplex valve cannot be installed on vehicles with planetary gearboxes.

source.text_it: Il distributore duplex è azionato dal convertitore pneumoidraulico

records.localized_text: The duplex valve is operated by the pneumatic-hydraulic converter.

source.text_it: Il distributore a mano dell'impianto frenante pneumatico invia aria al bielemento frenante per effettuare la frenatura di stazionamento

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system hand valve sends air to the dual brake actuator to apply the parking brake.

source.text_it: Il distributore a mano dell'impianto frenante pneumatico comanda il freno di stazionamento

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system hand valve controls the parking brake.

source.text_it: Il distributore a mano dell'impianto frenante pneumatico invia aria compressa nei freni a molla sia dell'assale anteriore che posteriore

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system hand valve sends compressed air to spring brakes on both front and rear axles.

source.text_it: Il distributore a mano dell'impianto frenante pneumatico agisce sul rallentatore di velocità

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system hand valve acts on the retarder.

source.text_it: Il distributore a mano dell'impianto frenante pneumatico viene attivato dal conducente per mezzo di un apposito comando manuale

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system hand valve is activated by the driver using a dedicated manual control.

source.text_it: L'insufficiente pressione dell'aria nei serbatoi di un impianto frenante pneumatico impedisce al veicolo munito di freno di stazionamento a molla di mettersi in movimento

records.localized_text: Insufficient tank air pressure prevents a vehicle with spring parking brakes from moving off.

source.text_it: Il distributore a mano dell'impianto frenante pneumatico comanda il bielemento frenante agendo sull'elemento a molla

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system hand valve controls the dual brake actuator through its spring element.

source.text_it: Il modulatore pressione-carico dell'impianto di frenatura viene regolato dal conducente in funzione del carico trasportato

records.localized_text: The braking system load-sensing pressure modulator is adjusted by the driver according to the load carried.

rows.text: The unit regulates and protects brake air pressure; the gearbox has a separate function.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §5, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5: compressore, regolatore, serbatoi, valvola di sicurezza, pedale e freni a molla.

rows.text: The governor controls the compressor, loading it at the lower threshold and unloading it at the upper one, restoring pressure when it falls.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §5, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5: compressore, regolatore, serbatoi, valvola di sicurezza, pedale e freni a molla.

rows.text: The safety valve releases air if pressure becomes excessive, protecting the reservoirs against overpressure.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §5, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5: compressore, regolatore, serbatoi, valvola di sicurezza, pedale e freni a molla.

rows.text: A check valve lets air flow into the reservoir but prevents it returning toward the source.
evidence: South Carolina Department of Education, Brake Manual, p. 7-20, Single Check Valve, General Information and Principles of Operation, https://trans.ed.sc.gov/aw/30-Maintenance/Brake%20Manual%20-31.pdf: la valvola a monte dei serbatoi fa passare aria verso di essi e impedisce il ritorno verso la sorgente.

rows.text: One atmosphere is not the reservoirs' structural test pressure: they must withstand pressures well above normal working pressure.
evidence: NHTSA, interpretazione 9128, FMVSS 121 S5.1.2.2, https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/9128: prova idrostatica strutturale dei serbatoi a pressione molto superiore a quella di esercizio; esempio statunitense, non limite italiano.

rows.text: A dedicated compressor compresses the brake air, which is stored in reservoirs; it is not taken from compression in the engine cylinders.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §5, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5: compressore, regolatore, serbatoi, valvola di sicurezza, pedale e freni a molla.

rows.text: The compressor supplies the reservoirs, which store compressed air for operating the brakes.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §5, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5: compressore, regolatore, serbatoi, valvola di sicurezza, pedale e freni a molla.

rows.text: The secondary brake must be able to stop the vehicle with a prescribed performance if service braking fails.
evidence: UNECE Regolamento 13, §§2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: funzioni di servizio, soccorso e stazionamento.

rows.text: In a common dual-circuit system the pedal controls both circuits; if one fails, the other can provide residual secondary braking.
evidence: UNECE Regolamento 13, §§2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: funzioni di servizio, soccorso e stazionamento.
Georgia DDS, §5.2, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-52-53: due circuiti condividono il comando; il circuito funzionante conserva capacità frenante.

rows.text: The parking brake warning light tells the driver that the brake is applied, distinguishing it from normal service braking.
evidence: UNECE regolamento 121, tabella 1, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A42016X0108%2801%29: spia del freno di stazionamento; Direttiva 78/316/CEE §2.13, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/1978/316/oj/eng: spia accesa quando il comando non è rilasciato.

rows.text: The dual brake valve receives air from the reservoirs and meters it to the service circuits when the pedal is pressed; it does not fill the reservoirs.
evidence: Bendix, Service Data SD-03-817, pp. 1–2, Description e Operation, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/QIYhwtZHI0EBhB_SD-03-817_1_US_007001.pdf: valvola duplex a pedale, due circuiti, aria in uscita e pressione graduata proporzionale allo sforzo; a fondo corsa aria dai serbatoi agli attuatori.
Bendix, Air Brake Charging System, figura 8, https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2019/MC-10163231-9999.pdf: compressore, regolatore ed essiccatore alimentano il serbatoio.

rows.text: The dual brake valve is operated by the brake pedal. The manual control is associated with the parking brake.
evidence: Bendix, Service Data SD-03-817, pp. 1–2, Description e Operation, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/QIYhwtZHI0EBhB_SD-03-817_1_US_007001.pdf: valvola duplex a pedale, due circuiti, aria in uscita e pressione graduata proporzionale allo sforzo; a fondo corsa aria dai serbatoi agli attuatori.

Knorr-Bremse, Brake Control Valves, Hand brake valves e Foot brake valves, https://truckservices.knorr-bremse.com/en/be/products/service-new-parts/conventional-braking-control/brake-control-valves/: la valvola a mano comanda lo stazionamento; quella a pedale comanda i circuiti di servizio.

rows.text: Pressing the pedal lets the dual brake valve pass air from the reservoirs to the service brake circuits and actuators.
evidence: Bendix, Service Data SD-03-817, pp. 1–2, Description e Operation, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/QIYhwtZHI0EBhB_SD-03-817_1_US_007001.pdf: valvola duplex a pedale, due circuiti, aria in uscita e pressione graduata proporzionale allo sforzo; a fondo corsa aria dai serbatoi agli attuatori.
Bendix, Air Brake Charging System, figura 8, https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2019/MC-10163231-9999.pdf: compressore, regolatore ed essiccatore alimentano il serbatoio.

rows.text: The pedal operates the valve, which varies the pressure sent to the actuators, allowing the driver to modulate braking.
evidence: Bendix, Service Data SD-03-817, pp. 1–2, Description e Operation, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/QIYhwtZHI0EBhB_SD-03-817_1_US_007001.pdf: valvola duplex a pedale, due circuiti, aria in uscita e pressione graduata proporzionale allo sforzo; a fondo corsa aria dai serbatoi agli attuatori.

rows.text: The dual brake valve meters brake air; the transmission differential allows the driven wheels to rotate at different speeds on a bend.
evidence: Bendix, Service Data SD-03-817, pp. 1–2, Description e Operation, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/QIYhwtZHI0EBhB_SD-03-817_1_US_007001.pdf: valvola duplex a pedale, due circuiti, aria in uscita e pressione graduata proporzionale allo sforzo; a fondo corsa aria dai serbatoi agli attuatori.

U.S. War Department, Automotive Power Transmission Units, Differential, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-W-6dfc6e0375832e323235f7e009fd2f76/html/GOVPUB-W-6dfc6e0375832e323235f7e009fd2f76.htm: il differenziale permette diverse velocità delle ruote in curva.

rows.text: The dual brake valve controls pneumatic brake circuits via the pedal; gearbox type neither determines its function nor imposes that prohibition.
evidence: Bendix, Service Data SD-03-817, pp. 1–2, Description e Operation, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/QIYhwtZHI0EBhB_SD-03-817_1_US_007001.pdf: valvola duplex a pedale, due circuiti, aria in uscita e pressione graduata proporzionale allo sforzo; a fondo corsa aria dai serbatoi agli attuatori.

Prevost, H3-41 Maintenance Manual, sezione 12 §13.4 e sezione 7 §11, https://www.manualslib.com/manual/2788283/Prevost-H3-41.html: i veicoli H3 usano valvola duplex E-8P e, per coach commerciali, cambio Allison B500; costituisce un esempio di abbinamento.

Allison Transmission, 4000/B500 Technicians’ Guide, pp. 43–47, P1 and P2 planetary modules, https://s7609befdab33e790.jimcontent.com/download/version/1631817245/module/7046708913/name/Allison%20Transmission%204000%20B500%20Series%204K%20Technicians%20Guide%20PDF.pdf: il B500 contiene gruppi epicicloidali; insieme al manuale Prevost dà un esempio compatibile, non la compatibilità di ogni modello.

rows.text: The dual brake valve is operated by the brake pedal and meters air to the circuits; it is not operated by the air-hydraulic converter.
evidence: Bendix, Service Data SD-03-817, pp. 1–2, Description e Operation, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/QIYhwtZHI0EBhB_SD-03-817_1_US_007001.pdf: valvola duplex a pedale, due circuiti, aria in uscita e pressione graduata proporzionale allo sforzo; a fondo corsa aria dai serbatoi agli attuatori.

rows.text: To apply a spring parking brake, the control exhausts air from the spring chamber: the spring supplies the braking force. Air releases it.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §§5.1.14–5.1.15, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5113: air holds spring brakes released; the parking control exhausts air to apply them and admits air to release them.

rows.text: The manual control operates the parking brake circuit, controlling pressure in the spring brake chamber.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §§5.1.14–5.1.15, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5113: air holds spring brakes released; the parking control exhausts air to apply them and admits air to release them.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but does not identify the vehicle or whether the control applies or releases the brake. In spring brakes, air normally compresses the spring to release them; venting the air lets the spring apply them. Which axles have spring brakes depends on the configuration.
evidence: Official CQC question 31243 printed FALSO; neither vehicle configuration nor apply/release direction of the hand control is specified. No official rationale inferred.

Georgia DDS CDL manual §§5.1.14–15 https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5113 — spring brakes held released by air and applied on pressure loss; hand/modulating controls and configurations described. US technical instruction, not Italian law.

Saskatchewan Government Insurance https://sgi.sk.ca/air-brake/-/knowledge_base/air-brake/spring-brake-chambers-emergency-park-brake — placement can include both rear tandem axles; the front axle of a tandem is not necessarily the vehicle steering axle.

rows.text: The hand valve controls the spring parking brake; the retarder is a separate device.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §§5.1.14–5.1.15, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5113: air holds spring brakes released; the parking control exhausts air to apply them and admits air to release them.

FMCSA, Motorcoach Brake Systems and Safety Technologies, Retarders, https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/carrier-safety/carrier-safety-resources/motorcoach-brake-systems-and-safety-technologies: retarders provide a separate means of slowing a moving vehicle and have their own on/off control.

rows.text: The driver applies the parking brake with a dedicated manual control, which controls the spring brake circuit.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §§5.1.14–5.1.15, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5113: air holds spring brakes released; the parking control exhausts air to apply them and admits air to release them.

rows.text: A spring brake requires compressed air to release it. If pressure is insufficient, the spring keeps it applied and prevents normal departure.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §§5.1.14–5.1.15, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5113: air holds spring brakes released; the parking control exhausts air to apply them and admits air to release them.

rows.text: The combined actuator has service and spring sections: the manual control operates the latter, exhausting or admitting air to apply or release the brake.
evidence: Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Driver Manual, §§5.1.14–5.1.15, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-5113: air holds spring brakes released; the parking control exhausts air to apply them and admits air to release them.

Saskatchewan Government Insurance, Air Brake Manual, Spring-brake chambers, https://sgi.sk.ca/air-brake/-/knowledge_base/air-brake/spring-brake-chambers-emergency-park-brake: the combined chamber has service and spring parking/emergency sections; the latter applies by spring force and releases by air pressure.

rows.text: The automatic load-sensing modulator adjusts braking pressure to the load detected by the vehicle; the driver does not adjust it for the load.
evidence: Knorr-Bremse, Brake Control Valves, Brake pressure regulators, https://truckservices.knorr-bremse.com/en/be/products/service-new-parts/conventional-braking-control/brake-control-valves/: i regolatori automatici adeguano la pressione alla condizione di carico del veicolo.

source_access_notes: Independently inspected Georgia DDS spring brake manual, SGI spring brake chamber description and tandem axle context, NHTSA 9128 hydrostatic test, Bendix SD-03-817, Prevost H3 maintenance manual §12.13.4 and §7.11 via ManualsLib, and Knorr automatic load regulator description. 31243 original has no figures and no vehicle configuration or apply/release direction; learner caveat preserves FALSO without invented axle exclusions. 31248 scoped to automatic regulators; manual load-sensing valves also exist in other applications.

issues.reason: La domanda indica FALSO per l’invio di aria ai freni a molla di entrambi gli assali, senza specificare la configurazione del veicolo né affermare che l’aria inserisca il freno.
